diff --git a/index.mjs b/index.mjs
index 4bff70b..49b5415 100644
--- a/index.mjs
+++ b/index.mjs
@@ -1 +1 @@
-export { slugify } from './lib/slug.mjs'
+export { slugify, uniqueSlug } from './lib/slug.mjs'
diff --git a/lib/slug.mjs b/lib/slug.mjs
index 30c170b..05d4626 100644
--- a/lib/slug.mjs
+++ b/lib/slug.mjs
@@ -1,3 +1,18 @@
 export function slugify(input) {
-  throw new Error('slugify is not implemented yet')
+  const text = String(input ?? '')
+    .normalize('NFD')
+    .replace(/\p{M}+/gu, '')
+    .toLowerCase()
+  return text
+    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu, '-')
+    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
+}
+
+export function uniqueSlug(base, taken = []) {
+  const stem = slugify(base)
+  const used = new Set(taken)
+  if (!used.has(stem)) return stem
+  let n = 2
+  while (used.has(`${stem}-${n}`)) n += 1
+  return `${stem}-${n}`
 }

artifacts.content:
All 4 tests pass (`# pass 4`, `# fail 0`).

## What was missing

- `lib/slug.mjs` only had a stub: `slugify` threw `Error('slugify is not implemented yet')`, and `uniqueSlug` didn't exist at all.
- `index.mjs` re-exported only `slugify`, but the test imports `uniqueSlug` from `./index.mjs`.

## Changes

**`lib/slug.mjs`** — implemented both functions:

- `slugify(input)`: normalizes to NFD and strips combining marks (so `Héllo` → `Hello`), lowercases, then replaces any run of non-letter/non-digit characters with a single `-` (handles spaces, punctuation, and repeated `--`), and trims leading/trailing dashes. Because separator runs collapse into one `-`, `a --  b` → `a-b` and the trimmed input `'  Héllo, World!  '` → `hello-world`.
- `uniqueSlug(base, taken)`: slugifies the base, returns it if unused, otherwise scans `stem-2`, `stem-3`, … until it finds a free suffix.

**`index.mjs`** — now exports both: `export { slugify, uniqueSlug } from './lib/slug.mjs'`.
